column2: This transcript is entirely host recap (Ian Hamilton) of a Kiriakou segment that aired in a prior hour not captured here, followed by a full interview with guest JP Lindroth about poetry/Mayan culture/Kafka/Hemingway. Kiriakou never speaks in this transcript; no verified first-person Kiriakou statements exist to extract. No findings emitted per hard rule (not the interviewee, host/other-guest-side segment).
